title: Preserve standalone M8 annotation subject context beyond DB 1.8.0
rationale: M8WorkspaceService.annotate_p4 persists InstructorAnnotationRevision independently. DB 1.8.0 debrief.annotation has no canonical carrier for subject_context_id, so exact restart reconstruction is impossible without a dedicated relation.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not store subject_context_id in audit JSON, evidence JSON, annotation body, object payloads, hashes, or UUID projections.
Do not mutate historical DB 1.8.0 authority bytes.
Do not broaden this ACP to unrelated P4/P5/P6 semantics.
separate_runtime_work: Extend the M8 repository port/adapter to register and exactly read P4SubjectContext and P5CompositionSnapshot.
Use assessment.annotation_subject_context when persisting or reading standalone annotations.
